abstract: A wide range of discrete head and neck tumors are developmental, including those termed choristoma, hamartoma, dermoid cysts, teratoid tumors, and true teratomas. In classifying various teratomas, consideration is given to the embryonal layers represented within the substance of the tumor and to their level of organizational complexity. By definition, a hamartoma is a tissue mass, present at or near the time of birth, that is benign and native to the site of origin. Growth capacity of a hamartomatous process parallels that of the host organism. A choristoma, on the other hand, is a mass of tissue that is foreign to the site of discovery and is thought to result from growth to displaced primordial tissue that is histologically normal for that tissue.
abstract_ja: 頭頸部の多くの限局性腫瘍は発生異常に由来し、迷入腫、過誤腫、類皮嚢腫、奇形腫様腫瘍、真の奇形腫などが含まれる。奇形腫を分類する際には、腫瘍の内部にみられる胚葉の構成と、その組織の組織化の複雑さの程度を考慮する。過誤腫は出生時またはその前後に存在する組織塊で、良性であり、発生部位に固有のものであり、その増殖能は宿主の成長に並行する。一方、迷入腫は発見部位にとって異所性の組織塊で、組織学的には正常な組織から成り、変位した原始組織の増殖に由来すると考えられる。
